summary: Taysha Gene Therapies filed an 8-K to disclose a material definitive agreement—an underwriting agreement with Jefferies and Goldman Sachs for an underwritten public offering of 32,500,001 common shares and 833,333 pre-funded warrants at $6.00 per share/$5.999 per warrant. The offering is a shelf takedown under an effective S-3ASR, expected to close June 26, 2026, with net proceeds of ~$187.4M. This routine capital raise is not a special situation; it is an ordinary equity issuance with no change of control, restructuring, or strategic event. What to watch: standard market price action post-offering.
